name: PostgreSQL server card
description: Hero panel for the cluster: stylised server illustration with a live status LED, plus key stats (connections, databases, tables, total size, replication lag). Bind each stat to its receiver metric.

spec.template:
LIVE postgresql cluster
Connections {{ format backends.value 'none' 0 }}
Databases {{ format dbCount.value 'none' 0 }}
Tables {{ format tableCount.value 'none' 0 }}
Total size {{ format totalSize.value 'bytes' 1 }}
WAL age {{ format walAge.value 'seconds' 0 }}
Replication lag {{ format replLag.value 'seconds' 1 }}
spec.styles: .psc { display: flex; height: 100%; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; gap: 1rem; align-items: stretch; } .psc .left { flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.25rem 0; } .psc .rack { height: 100%; max-height: 14rem; width: auto; } .psc .rack .cab { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 8%, transparent); } .psc .rack .cab-line { fill: none; stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 28%, transparent); stroke-width: 1.2; } .psc .rack .unit rect:first-child { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 14%, transparent); stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 26%, transparent); stroke-width: 0.6; } .psc .rack .vent { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 32%, transparent); } .psc .rack .led-power { fill: var(--color-sage-500); } .psc .rack .led-act { fill: var(--color-graphite-400); } .psc .rack .led-act.vellum-th-ok   { fill: var(--color-sage-500);  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-sage-500) 90%, transparent)); } .psc .rack .led-act.vellum-th-warn { fill: var(--color-amber-500); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-amber-500) 90%, transparent)); } .psc .rack .led-act.vellum-th-bad  { fill: var(--color-rust-500);  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-rust-500) 90%, transparent)); } .psc .rack .disk { fill: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ember-500) 16%, transparent); stroke: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-ember-500) 50%, transparent); stroke-width: 0.6; } .psc .rack .disk-lbl { fill: var(--color-ember-600); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; } .psc .right { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.55rem; } .psc .hdr { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding-top: 0.1rem; } .psc .live { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: var(--color-graphite-500); padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 8%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); } .psc .ldot { width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-sage-500); animation: psc-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } .psc .ldot.vellum-th-warn { background: var(--color-amber-500); } .psc .ldot.vellum-th-bad  { background: var(--color-rust-500); } @keyframes psc-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.85); } } .psc .title { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-graphite-700); } .psc .grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 0.55rem; flex: 1; align-content: start; } .psc .kv { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.1rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.65rem; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 5%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-graphite-500) 13%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-md); min-width: 0; } .psc .k { font-size: 0.6rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--color-graphite-500); } .psc .kv strong { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .psc .kv strong.vellum-th-ok   { color: var(--color-sage-600); } .psc .kv strong.vellum-th-warn { color: var(--color-amber-600); } .psc .kv strong.vellum-th-bad  { color: var(--color-rust-600); }

dataBindings.name: backends
dataBindings.description: postgresql.backends — total active connections (typically summed across DBs)

dataBindings.name: dbCount
dataBindings.description: postgresql.database.count — number of databases on the cluster

dataBindings.name: tableCount
dataBindings.description: postgresql.table.count — total tables (often summed across DBs)

dataBindings.name: totalSize
dataBindings.description: postgresql.db_size — sum across DBs for total cluster footprint

dataBindings.name: walAge
dataBindings.description: postgresql.wal.age — seconds since the oldest WAL was written

dataBindings.name: replLag
dataBindings.description: postgresql.replication.data_delay — seconds the replica is behind. Drives the status LED color.
